initial_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the initial image directory shown on launch. If empty, shows all known pictures.

auto_import.description: If true, automatically imports new photos from import_dirs on startup.

import_dirs.description: List of directories to monitor for new photos when auto_import is true.

thumbnail_cache_limit.description: Maximum size (in MB) for the thumbnail cache. Use 0 for unlimited.

enable_face_recognition.description: Enable face recognition if the binary includes support. No effect if unsupported.

lang.description: Language code (e.g., en_US, zh_CN). Empty string means use system locale.
